notes.title: 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening to all you puzzle masters! [/h3][p][b]Exciting times are here! [/b]The latest installment in the 3D Escape Room series - [b][i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i][/b]- -[b]is now officially available on Steam! [/b][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Since the demo version was released two months ago, we have received a great deal of valuable feedback and suggestions from players. Thank you all very much for your enthusiastic participation! [/p][p]It is with your voices that we have [b]polished and optimized[/b] the game experience in [b]many ways[/b] in the official version, striving to present a more perfect state. [/p][p][/p][p][b]As the much-anticipated sequel, our goal is to [/b]bring you that long-lost sense of classic escapism, while incorporating[b] More novel surprises[/b]! We've gone all out to bring [b]all-around evolution[/b] while inheriting the essence of its predecessor:[/p][list][*][p][b]A wider visual dimension: a new goggle feature! [/b] - Unlock a whole new perspective on the world! [/p][/*][*][p][b]MORE IMMERSIVE STORY: A complete and suspenseful storyline[/b] - Uncover the manor's dusty secrets step by step. [/p][/*][*][p][b]RICHER EXPLORATION: 16 SECRET ROOMS & OVER 12 HOURS OF GAMEPLAY[/b] - Satisfy your craving for immersive puzzle solving. [/p][/*][*][p][b]MORE BRAIN-BLOWING CHALLENGES: More ingenious puzzles & fun mini-games[/b] - Stimulate your logic & insight. [/p][/*][*][p][b]More exquisite visual experience: comprehensively upgraded beautiful models[/b] - to create a more realistic and fascinating environment for you. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎁 [/b]Premiere Discounts & Demo Version[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Limited Time Premiere Discounts:[/b] To celebrate the release, [b]now through August 7[/b], get [b]20% off[/b] when you purchase [b][i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i][/b]! Now, my friends, is the perfect time to return to the secret room! [/p][/*][*][p][b]The demo is still open:[/b] Still on the fence? Or are you a new player who just discovered us? Feel free to download the [b]free demo[/b] on the store page to get a taste of the game for yourself! [/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]🗣️ Join our puzzle community! [/h3][p]We invite all players to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Join the Steam Community Discussion Forum[/b] and share your tips, secrets, or challenges! [/p][/*][*][p]Your feedback is vital to us! Our team will [b]keep an eye on the community[/b] and further optimize and update the game based on players' opinions to polish the game experience to perfection. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Now, it's time to push open the dusty door of [i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i] and reveal its deep secrets! We'll see you in the puzzles! [/b][/p]
